summary: Phases 1-3 complete, committed, and build-verified: added a narrow security.polkit.extraConfig rule granting root suspend-ignore-inhibit in modules/system/power.nix (nixos-rebuild build exit 0, nix flake check exit 0, closure-grep and node --check pass), committed tests/battery-suspend-backstop-offline.sh (16/16 assertions, idempotent), and corrected two false polkit-authorization claims in docs/. Phase 4 blocked: USER CHECKLIST (U1-U4) requires sudo and a real suspend cycle, which this agent must not run. Build-green/offline-green prove nothing about live suspend authorization.

blockers.description: Phase 4 USER CHECKLIST (U1-U4) is unexecuted: activating the change (sudo nixos-rebuild switch), a root pkcheck authorization gate, and a real session-less systemctl suspend -i probe all require sudo and/or a real suspend/resume cycle, which this agent is not permitted to run. polkit also refuses cross-identity CheckAuthorization() for untrusted callers, so there is no agent-side substitute. The user must run the checklist in specs/123_fix_backstop_polkit_denial_live_verification/plans/01_backstop-polkit-fix.md Phase 4 and report results.

decisions_made: security.polkit.extraConfig used (not environment.etc symlink to the shipped .example) -- matches in-tree nixpkgs precedent and narrows the grant to suspend only.
Offline suite committed at tests/battery-suspend-backstop-offline.sh, 108 lines (~8% over the 70-100 soft envelope, annotated as a deviation), with mandatory caveat header and known-gap footer.
Doc corrections in docs/ omit task-number/specs/ path citations per .claude/rules/no-task-references-in-deliverables.md (docs/ is outside specs/**); annotated as deviations.
nix flake check passed clean this round (exit 0) -- not a known-expected-failure case; reported honestly rather than presumed.
dead_ends: No agent-side substitute exists for the root pkcheck / real suspend probes -- polkit's cross-identity CheckAuthorization() refusal is a security boundary, not a tooling gap; do not attempt to work around it.
